H8123.name: Samson
H8123.brief: Israelite judge with great strength from God
H8123.short: Samson was an Israelite judge known for his God-given strength, which he used to fight against the Philistines.

H8165B.name: Seir
H8165B.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H8165B.brief: Horite chief, ancestor of the Horites of Seir
H8165B.short: Seir was a Horite chief and an ancestor of the Horites who inhabited the land of Seir.

H8188.name: Seorim
H8188.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8188.brief: Priest during David's reign, head of the fourth division
H8188.short: Seorim was a priest who served during David's reign and was the head of the fourth priestly division.

H8174G.name: Shaaph
H8174G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8174G.short: Shaaph, a son of Jahdai, was a descendant of Caleb.

H8174H.name: Shaaph
H8174H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8174H.short: Shaaph, a son of Caleb's concubine Maacah, was the father of Madmannah.

H8190.name: Shaashgaz
H8190.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8190.brief: Eunuch in charge of King Ahasuerus' concubines
H8190.short: Shaashgaz was the eunuch appointed by King Ahasuerus to be in charge of the concubines in the royal harem.

H8125.name: Shamsherai
H8125.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8125.short: Shamsherai was a Benjamite descendant who lived in Jerusalem during the time of the genealogical records in 1 Chronicles.

H8187.name: Sheariah
H8187.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8187.short: Sheariah was a Benjamite, the son of Azel, and is mentioned in the genealogical records of 1 Chronicles.

H8114G.name: Shemariah
H8114G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8114G.short: Shemariah, a Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag while he was hiding from Saul.

H8114H.name: Shemariah
H8114H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8114H.short: Shemariah, a son of King Rehoboam and Abihail, the daughter of Eliab.

H8114I.name: Shemariah
H8114I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8114I.brief: Israelite who married a foreign woman
H8114I.short: Shemariah, an Israelite who was among those who had married foreign women during the exile.

H8114J.name: Shemariah
H8114J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8114J.brief: Israelite who married a foreign woman
H8114J.short: Shemariah, another Israelite who was among those who had married foreign women during the exile.

H8106B.name: Shemed
H8106B.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8106B.short: Shemed, a son of Elpaal, who built Ono and Lod with its towns.

H8106G.name: Shemer
H8106G.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8106G.brief: Levite of the family of Merari
H8106G.short: Shemer, a Levite of the family of Merari, an ancestor of Ethan the singer.

H8106A.name: Shemer
H8106A.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8106A.short: Shemer, the original owner of the hill of Samaria, which Omri bought from him.

H8137.name: Shenazzar
H8137.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8137.brief: Descendant of King Jeconiah (Jehoiachin) of Judah
H8137.short: Shenazzar, a descendant of King Jeconiah (Jehoiachin) of Judah, born during the Babylonian captivity.

H8195.name: Shepho
H8195.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H8195.short: Shepho, a Horite chief, the son of Shobal, who lived in the land of Seir.

H8100G.name: Shimeath
H8100G.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8100G.brief: Mother of Jozacar, one of King Joash's assassins.
H8100G.short: Shimeath was an Ammonitess, the mother of Jozacar (or 'Jozachar'), one of the assassins of King Joash of Judah.

H8119.name: Shimrath
H8119.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8119.brief: Benjamite descendant of Shimei, son of Elpaal.
H8119.short: Shimrath was a Benjamite descendant of Shimei, the son of Elpaal.

H8113H.name: Shimri
H8113H.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8113H.brief: One of David's mighty warriors from the tribe of Benjamin.
H8113H.short: Shimri was one of David's mighty warriors from the tribe of Benjamin.

H8113I.name: Shimri
H8113I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8113I.brief: Levite gatekeeper during David's reign, son of Hosah.
H8113I.short: Shimri was a Levite gatekeeper during David's reign and the son of Hosah.

H8113G.name: Shimri
H8113G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8113G.brief: Simeonite descendant of Shimei in Hezekiah's time.
H8113G.short: Shimri was a Simeonite descendant of Shimei who lived during the reign of King Hezekiah.

H8113J.name: Shimri
H8113J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8113J.brief: Levite who helped purify the temple under King Hezekiah.
H8113J.short: Shimri was a Levite who assisted in purifying the temple during the reign of King Hezekiah.

H8110B.name: Shimron
H8110B.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8110B.brief: Son of Issachar and progenitor of the Shimronites.
H8110B.short: Shimron was a son of Issachar and the progenitor of the Shimronite clan within the tribe of Issachar.

H8124.name: Shimshai
H8124.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8124.brief: Scribe who opposed the rebuilding of Jerusalem.
H8124.short: Shimshai was a scribe who, along with Rehum the commander, wrote a letter to King Artaxerxes opposing the rebuilding of Jerusalem.

H8134.name: Shinab
H8134.desc: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
H8134.brief: King of Admah who rebelled against Chedorlaomer.
H8134.short: Shinab was the king of Admah who, along with other kings, rebelled against Chedorlaomer, king of Elam.

H8126.name: Shumathites
H8126.brief: A family of Kirjath-jearim, descendants of Judah.
H8126.short: The Shumathites were a family from Kirjath-jearim, descendants of Judah through Shobal.

H8111.name: Samaria
H8111.brief: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants
H8111.short: Samaria was the capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel, and its inhabitants were known as Samaritans (<ref="1Ki. 16:24; 2Ki. 17:24; Jhn. 4:9; Act.8.5">1Ki. 16:24; 2Ki. 17:24; Jhn. 4:9; Act.8.5</ref>).

H8165A.name: Seir
H8165A.brief: Region inhabited by Edomites, descendants of Esau
H8165A.short: Seir was a mountainous region inhabited by the Edomites, the descendants of Esau (<ref="Gen. 32:3; 36:8; Num. 24:18; Deut. 2:4; Josh. 24:4">Gen. 32:3; 36:8; Num. 24:18; Deut. 2:4; Josh. 24:4</ref>).

H8165G.name: Seir Mount
H8165G.brief: Mountainous region in Seir, associated with Edom
H8165G.short: Mount Seir refers to the mountainous region within Seir, often associated with the Edomites (<ref="Deut. 1:2; 2:1, 5; 1Chr. 4:42; Ezek. 35:2, 3, 7, 15">Deut. 1:2; 2:1, 5; 1Chr. 4:42; Ezek. 35:2, 3, 7, 15</ref>).

H8165H.name: Seir Mount
H8165H.brief: Landmark on the boundary of Judah
H8165H.short: Mount Seir was a landmark on the boundary of Judah, near Kiriath-jearim and Chesalon (<ref="Josh. 15:10">Josh. 15:10</ref>).

H8167.name: Seirah
H8167.brief: Place where Ehud escaped after killing Eglon
H8167.short: Seirah was the place to which Ehud escaped after killing Eglon, the king of Moab (<ref="Judg. 3:26">Judg. 3:26</ref>).

H8169.name: Shaalbim
H8169.brief: Town in Dan, home of David's mighty men
H8169.short: Shaalbim, also called Shaalabbin, was a town allotted to the tribe of Dan (<ref="Josh. 19:42; Judg. 1:35">Josh. 19:42; Judg. 1:35</ref>) and the hometown of some of David's mighty men (<ref="2Sam. 23:32; 1Chr. 11:33">2Sam. 23:32; 1Chr. 11:33</ref>). It was also a town under Solomon's administration (<ref="1Ki. 4:9">1Ki. 4:9</ref>).

H8171.name: Shaalim
H8171.brief: Region traversed by Saul in search of donkeys
H8171.short: Shaalim was a region through which Saul passed while searching for his father's lost donkeys (<ref="1Sam. 9:4">1Sam. 9:4</ref>).

H8189G.name: Shaaraim
H8189G.brief: Town in Judah; site of Philistine retreat
H8189G.short: Shaaraim was a town in the Shephelah of Judah (<ref="Josh. 15:36">Josh. 15:36</ref>) and a place the Philistines passed in their retreat from Socoh (<ref="1Sam. 17:52">1Sam. 17:52</ref>).

H8129.name: Shen
H8129.brief: Place where Samuel set up the Ebenezer stone
H8129.short: Shen was the place where Samuel set up the Ebenezer stone to commemorate the Israelites' victory over the Philistines (<ref="1Sam. 7:12">1Sam. 7:12</ref>).

H8110A.name: Shimron
H8110A.brief: Canaanite city conquered by Joshua, allotted to Zebulun
H8110A.short: Shimron, also called Shimron-meron, was a Canaanite city conquered by Joshua (<ref="Josh. 11:1; 12:20">Josh. 11:1; 12:20</ref>) and later allotted to the tribe of Zebulun (<ref="Josh. 19:15">Josh. 19:15</ref>).

H8152.name: Shinar
H8152.brief: Ancient region in Mesopotamia, associated with Babylon
H8152.short: Shinar was an ancient region in Mesopotamia, associated with the cities of Babylon and Uruk, and the site of the Tower of Babel (<ref="Gen. 10:10; 11:2; 14:1, 9; Josh. 7:21; Isa. 11:11; Dan. 1:2; Zech. 5:11">Gen. 10:10; 11:2; 14:1, 9; Josh. 7:21; Isa. 11:11; Dan. 1:2; Zech. 5:11</ref>).

H8101.name: Shimeathite
H8101.brief: A Kenite clan skilled in scribal arts
H8101.short: The Shimeathites were a Kenite clan known for their scribal skills, mentioned in <ref="1Ch.2.55">1Ch.2.55</ref> among the descendants of Salma.
